<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Incident" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/incident-management">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_IncidentReport" name="Incident report"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IncidentManagement" name="Incident Management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IncidentReported" name="Incident reported">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_IncidentReported" messageRef="Message_IncidentReport"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogReport" name="Log report in tracking system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignTeam" name="Assign report to appropriate team">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvestigateCause" name="Gather information and identify cause">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProposeActions" name="Propose corrective actions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ImplementSolution" name="Implement solution (fix, training or policy change)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUp" name="Follow up to ensure incident does not recur">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseReport" name="Close incident report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyStakeholders" name="Notify all stakeholders">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IncidentClosed" name="Incident closed and stakeholders notified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IncidentReported" targetRef="Task_LogReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_LogReport" targetRef="Task_AssignTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignTeam" targetRef="Task_InvestigateCause"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_InvestigateCause" targetRef="Task_ProposeActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ProposeActions" targetRef="Task_ImplementSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ImplementSolution" targetRef="Task_FollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_FollowUp" targetRef="Task_CloseReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_CloseReport" targetRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders" targetRef="EndEvent_IncidentClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
